scored_by: gemini-3.5-flash-lite via scripts/rubric.mjs, two passes per asset (A on the 8x plain view, B on the debug sheet), re-scored after the 2026-11-13 redraw

verdict.note: Re-score after the redraw of six assets. Mean 3.69 against 4.0, so the bar is still missed. Structure improved sharply (cluster_discipline 3.93->4.57, silhouette 4.64->4.86) while lighting 3.14->2.79, value separation 3.86->3.57 and palette 3.43->3.21 fell: the hand-painted tones are flatter than the previous light and ramp passes. The untouched prop moved 4.25->3.92, which puts single-asset noise at about 0.33 and makes every asset delta except cluster discipline indistinguishable from it.

silhouette.why: The distinct flask shape with a cork and bulbous base is instantly readable even without color information.

value_separation.why: The liquid, glass, and cork values separate well, though a few adjacent glass tones are quite close in value.

lighting.why: The lighting is generally consistent from the top-left, but the internal shading on the liquid feels slightly ambiguous.

edge_language.why: The heavy dark outline clearly defines the silhouette, while internal color transitions cleanly separate the materials.

cluster_discipline.why: There is no single-pixel confetti, with all pixel clusters forming solid, intentional shapes.

palette_craft.why: The muted cyan glass and reddish liquid hues fit the subject nicely, though the ramps could step slightly more evenly.
